items.reason: Removing internal value changes flattened the approved detailed SD anime cel-shaded direction into a simplified vector-like style.

Ordinary hit recoil must reuse the active pose with runtime displacement, rotation, tint, hit-stop and FX; a separate full character drawing adds cost and conflicts with the adopted low-cost animation rule.
Checkerboard transparency was baked into an RGB image; the reusable character master requires genuine alpha with no background pixels.
The extracted RGBA subject keeps 64 px of transparent space below the sandals, which breaks the shared 0.965 foot pivot and makes the runtime sprite float.
Third and final automatic attempt baked the checkerboard into RGB again and began repainting details instead of preserving the v2 subject. Automatic iteration stopped at the configured limit.
Rain streaks are baked across the reusable background; Area 01 weather must remain a runtime layer so intensity can vary by node and does not contaminate UI or actor silhouettes.
